# clean_game_metadata_files

[← Command index](README.md)

Rewrite every platform's Pegasus metadata file with its entries in sorted order.

## Synopsis

```
clean_game_metadata_files [options]
```

## Description

For each category and subcategory, reads the metadata file
`Pegasus/Roms/<category>/<subcategory>/metadata.pegasus.txt` in the game metadata
repository, if it exists, and writes it back with entries sorted by name and the
collection header and launch command regenerated.

`sort_game_metadata` does the same for every metadata file it finds under `Pegasus/`,
including ones outside the known subcategories.

## Options

### Common options

| Option | Description |
|--------|-------------|
| `-v, --verbose` | Enable verbose mode. |
| `-p, --pretend_run` | Do a pretend run with no permanent changes. |
| `-x, --exit_on_failure` | Enable exit on failure mode. |
| `--no-preview` | Skip the preview confirmation prompt. |

## Examples

### Sort every metadata file

```bash
clean_game_metadata_files
```

### Sort without the confirmation prompt

```bash
clean_game_metadata_files --no-preview
```

## Notes

- There are no selection options; every known subcategory is processed.
